text: Living a healthy life involves more than just eating your vegetables. A balanced diet provides your body with essential nutrients, including fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and proteins. Physical exercise, even a daily walk, strengthens your heart and muscles. Sleep is equally important, as it helps your body recover and your mind stay sharp. Don't forget mental health—managing stress and staying connected with friends and family makes a big difference. Finally, a good work-life balance helps you avoid burnout and enjoy your personal time. By caring for all these areas, you can build a happier and more energetic life.
